module: Auxiliary controller for the landing legs of a trailer with an electric linear actuator (type "auxiliary"). Same logic as hydraulics/hydraulicTrailerFeet: it stores the cylinder positions in the attached and detached states and automatically brings the legs back on coupling or uncoupling, by writing the motor command into electrics. The difference: the actuator is a powertrain device and one can filter on a specific coupler node.
notes: jbeam keys (default): linearActuatorName (device name, required), motorThrottleElectricsName (name of the command electrics value; otherwise inferred from motorName or from the actuator's propulsion device via motor.electricsThrottleName), motorName, attachedDefaultPosition (0), detachedDefaultPosition (1), couplerNodeName (name of the coupler node to listen to; without it, no coupler hook triggers because nodeId == nil fails), startValue (0).
Positions as an extension ratio 0..1 (actuator.currentExtendPercent). The command is -1/0/1.
The onCouplerAttached/onCouplerDetached hooks only react if the other object is another vehicle AND if nodeId matches couplerNodeName.

init.desc: Finds the actuator and the command electrics name, initializes positions and states.

updateGFX.desc: Writes the motor command (manual or automatic toward the stored position).

onCouplerAttached.desc: Hook called by the engine on coupling; starts the movement toward the "attached" position.

onCouplerDetached.desc: Hook called on uncoupling; starts the movement toward the "detached" position.

moveFeet.desc: Manual command of the legs, -1 to 1; interrupts an automatic movement.

getState.desc: Returns the state (positions, manual input, coupling state).

setState.desc: Restores the state returned by getState.
